additional_context: CapabilityStatement is active in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-I minutes from 2020-01-20 treated FHIR-13858 as a tooling issue, and artifact-term searches found no conflicting Zulip or Confluence discussion. The current CI Turtle output for capabilitystatement-example contains neither familymemberhistory-genetic nor the reported rdf:type triples.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit on the combined branch. No source file was changed because the active source and generated Turtle surface already satisfy the issue request.
